aggregation: 1to1, primary target form, seeds 0..4; median per model; missing any seed value gives null. Ensemble is median of ef2full/ef2fast/ptxv2 ipSAE medians.
single_score_selection: Highest PD-L1 average precision among the four feature rankings over the full labeled pool; missing scores form a tied bottom group, break feature ties by name. No evaluation-target tuning.
heuristic: Arithmetic mean of four within-target midrank percentiles; null gets 0. Equal feature weights are a descriptive rule, not independent evidence weights.
ties_and_fixed_order: Ascending anonymous candidate ID; IDs use SHA256 of a stored random salt and source UUID, independent of scores and labels.
primary_endpoint: Source binder_final unchanged: combined vendor/refit rubric with sensorgram review, not a new MolClaw measurement.
missing_labels: Exclude null composite labels, report counts; never convert missing to negative.
vendor_sensitivity: Binder/non_binder only for each vendor separately; not_expressed/not_measured/not_tested/inconclusive remain unknown. Keep selections fixed, report denominators.
comparison: Same candidate pools, same four visible fields and quota for every policy; reveal evaluation labels only after all six host submissions are accepted.
uncertainty: Descriptive percentile bootstrap over targets, seed 20260906, 2000 replicates; paired precision differences against heuristic and development_best_single.
limitations: Exploratory retrospective target-disjoint analysis; source article target-level results were already known, no pristine holdout or preregistration claim.
Public selected candidate pool, correlated designs and only six evaluation targets; candidate count is not independent replication.
Host feature-only access is a protocol, not filesystem isolation; public-data training contamination remains possible.
Published post-hoc complex scores differ from MolClaw native monomer and geometry features; no validation of the complete current generation policy.
No new GPU inference, synthesis, functional validation, prospective hits, or compute-saving estimate. Quota is a selection count, not actual wet-lab spending.
missing_scores: Every eligible candidate requires at least one finite score; otherwise preparation fails. Missing individual scores rank below observed values, and missingness counts are reported.
